URL: https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/andy-burnham-prime-minister-circuit-breaker-b3018299.html
NOTE: The Independent (20-21 Jul 2026). Burnham, speaking to journalists in the Downing Street rose garden, made clear he wants to fix the social care crisis before leaving office (expected to ask the Casey Commission to fast-track reforms from 2028 to end of this year). Verbatim Burnham on NHS/care: "If I look at the National Health Service right now, what I hear from people is that corridor care is becoming the norm all year round, not just in winter time, and the standards in relation to A&E are just not achievable in terms of the 90-plus per cent of people coming through in four hours." Also: welfare-bill cut "is the fair and sustainable way to bring the welfare bill down, to meet our fiscal rules, and to honour our commitments on defence to our international partners." APPROVED SOURCE.
